description: SimStadt is published by HFT Stuttgart. It describes an urban simulation environment that uses CityGML to estimate building heat demand, photovoltaic potential and refurbishment scenarios. Its documentation reports an MIT open-source release in September 2026. Its scope is generic model use; applicability and spatial or temporal resolution depend on the supplied case and inputs. Access is through the public metadata page and its provider links. Software was not installed or executed. Licence: MIT. The public page or repository can be read without payment; this does not establish free access to every linked artefact. The metadata establishes the resource, but its files, accuracy and dependency compatibility were not tested. This review identifies optimisation, capacity planning as potential simulation uses, subject to the stated limits. Related catalogue records are model-opendata2citygml-energy-workflow. These are contextual links; no unverified interoperability or actual use is claimed.
